script.description: Coerce dot_number to a real JSON integer in _source so the crashes-enrichment-policy's internal enrich index stores a clean '2975796' instead of a float-suffixed '2975796.0' that would never term-match carriers' integer dot_number. A 'convert' processor (type: long) was rejected because Elasticsearch's convert-to-long calls Long.parseLong() on the value's string form, which throws on decimal-point strings like '3240797.0'; a Painless '(long)' cast does not have this limitation.
